title: "Let Me Repeat That." What Enron's President Told Investors

lines.say: For Enron, the situation in California had little impact on fourth quarter results. Let me repeat that.

scene.q: [F]or Enron, the situation in California had little impact on fourth quarter results. Let me repeat that.
scene.cite: As quoted in Superseding Indictment, Cr. No. H-04-25

lines.say: Enron's president, Jeffrey Skilling, to analysts in January two thousand one. Prosecutors said he knew California's utilities likely couldn't pay what they owed.
lines.show: Enron's president, Jeffrey Skilling, to analysts in January 2001. Prosecutors said he knew California's utilities likely couldn't pay what they owed.

lines.say: That December, Enron went bankrupt. In two thousand six, a jury convicted him on nineteen counts.
